# SoftBank Robot Assets

`raise_both_hands_b001.qianim` comes from the official
SoftBank Robotics QiSDK tutorials at revision
`5f8839a018516982d8672814bbd77e05fe44796b`.

`raise_left_hand_b001.qianim` and `raise_right_hand_b001.qianim` are derived from
the official raise-both-hands animation by muting the opposite arm actuator
curves. They retain the official safe poses and contain no base trajectory.

The source is distributed under the BSD 3-Clause license reproduced in
`softbank-qisdk-tutorials-BSD-3-Clause.txt`.
